properties.statement: Built a pull request's design record by hand, four times in one day (two PRs, one of them twice after main moved): imported main's committed export into a throwaway store inside the PR's worktree, recorded the PR's change event and accepted the drifted artifacts' checksums there, exported onto the branch, and ran the coherence gate. Done this way because the live shared store holds records not yet folded into main, so exporting from it would have dragged them into the PR; and a second PR writing the same export had to be regenerated by hand after the first merged.
